project_info.theme: Quán Nhậu Tự Do new menu hero poster
project_info.color_palette: Dark green, warm yellow, beer gold, wood brown, food natural tones

main_subject.detail: Wide restaurant promotional banner with two hands clinking frosty beer glasses above a feast-filled wooden table of Vietnamese drinking dishes and hotpot, paired with oversized yellow typography announcing many new menu items.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic food advertising, polished hospitality campaign, rich appetizing textures

composition_elements.text: QUÁN NHẬU TỰ DO / CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO / MỞ VỊ MỚI / 30+ MÓN NHẬU MỚI TOANH / *1986 / quannhautudo.com
items: Top Left: Quán Nhậu Tự Do logo in white on the dark green background.
Top Right: Two raised hands clinking full beer glasses with bright highlight flare.
Bottom Left: Contact row with phone icon and '*1986' plus globe icon and 'quannhautudo.com'.
Bottom Right: Large wooden table overflowing with dishes including hotpot, grilled fish, stir-fried dishes, salad, side bowls, and condiments.
Center/Background: Giant stacked headline 'CHẠM CỐC TỰ DO' in white and 'MỞ VỊ MỚI' in oversized yellow letters, with a yellow brush label '30+ MÓN NHẬU MỚI TOANH'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Glossy highlights on beer foam, appetizing directional light on dishes, subtle background venue blur, vibrant hospitality energy
